title: Can Rabbits Eat Bananas?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Bananas?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage, bedding guide, hay guide and apple guide.
-->

<section class="rcbn-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-bananas">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcbn-page,
    .rcbn-page * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main {
      background: #fef4f0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image {
      display: none !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * {
      margin-block-start: 0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcbn-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcbn-page a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .rcbn-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcbn-wrap {
      width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rcbn-narrow {
      width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rcbn-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcbn-pill::before {
      content: "✦";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
    }

    .rcbn-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcbn-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcbn-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .rcbn-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcbn-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcbn-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcbn-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcbn-hero-cover {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rcbn-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcbn-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcbnFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcbn-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcbn-hero-title-overlay .rcbn-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcbn-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcbn-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcbn-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcbn-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcbn-breadcrumb a {
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
    }

    .rcbn-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcbn-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcbn-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcbn-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rcbn-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcbn-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcbn-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcbn-quickbar {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 4;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .rcbn-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcbn-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcbn-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rcbn-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rcbn-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcbn-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcbn-section {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .rcbn-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcbn-section h2,
    .rcbn-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcbn-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcbn-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcbn-content {
      display: grid;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .rcbn-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcbn-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcbn-panel > * {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .rcbn-panel h2 {
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rcbn-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcbn-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rcbn-panel p:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .rcbn-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcbn-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcbn-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcbn-treat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcbn-treat-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcbn-treat-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcbn-treat-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .rcbn-treat-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.22rem;
    }

    .rcbn-treat-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcbn-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcbn-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcbn-warning-card h2 {
      color: var(--rc-danger);
    }

    .rcbn-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rcbn-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcbn-warning-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcbn-warning-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rcbn-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rcbn-image-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 430px;
    }

    .rcbn-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rcbn-image-card img:hover {
      transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important;
    }

    .rcbn-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rcbn-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rcbn-prep {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcbn-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcbn-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcbn-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcbn-step h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.16rem;
    }

    .rcbn-step p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcbn-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcbn-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcbn-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcbn-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcbn-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcbn-side-card a:hover {
      transform: translateX(4px);
      background: #fff4d8;
    }

    .rcbn-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcbn-note strong {
      color: var(--rc-moss);
    }

    .rcbn-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcbn-benefit {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcbn-benefit h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcbn-benefit p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcbn-final {
      padding: 70px 0 42px;
      background: #fef4f0;
    }

    .rcbn-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-bananas-2.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcbn-final-box .rcbn-pill,
    .rcbn-final-box h2,
    .rcbn-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcbn-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcbn-final-box .rcbn-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rcbn-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rcbn-related,
    .rcbn-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcbn-related .rcbn-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rcbn-related .rcbn-section-header .rcbn-pill {
      color: #4e6b45 !important;
    }

    .rcbn-related .rcbn-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcbn-related .rcbn-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

          <h2>Use banana as a tiny bonding treat</h2>
          <p>
            Because rabbits usually enjoy sweet fruit, bananas can work well as a training or bonding treat. The key is to use a very small amount and avoid giving banana too often.
          </p>
          <p>
            If your rabbit has never tried banana before, introduce it slowly and watch for any changes in appetite, poo or behaviour afterwards.
          </p>
          <div class="rcbn-btns">
            <a class="rcbn-btn rcbn-btn-primary" href="/what-do-rabbits-eat">Read the full rabbit food guide</a>
            <a class="rcbn-btn rcbn-btn-secondary" href="/best-hay-for-rabbits">Read the hay guide</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcbn-section rcbn-prep rcbn-reveal" id="prepare">
      <div class="rcbn-wrap">
        <div class="rcbn-section-header">
          <span class="rcbn-pill">Simple preparation</span>
          <h2>How to prepare banana for rabbits</h2>
          <p>
            Before feeding banana to your rabbit, prepare it properly and introduce it slowly, especially if your rabbit has not eaten it before.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcbn-steps">
          <article class="rcbn-step">
            <b>1</b>
            <h3>Wash before peeling</h3>
            <p>Wash the banana before peeling to reduce dirt or residue transferring to the fruit.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbn-step">
            <b>2</b>
            <h3>Cut a tiny slice</h3>
            <p>Offer only a very small piece of the banana fruit.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbn-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Feed occasionally</h3>
            <p>Use banana as an occasional treat, not a daily food.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbn-step">
            <b>4</b>
            <h3>Remove leftovers</h3>
            <p>Remove any uneaten banana after a short time so it does not become sticky or spoiled.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcbn-section rcbn-reveal" id="benefits">
      <div class="rcbn-wrap">
        <div class="rcbn-section-header">
          <span class="rcbn-pill">Treat benefits</span>
          <h2>Benefits and signs your rabbit enjoys banana</h2>
          <p>
            When fed occasionally, banana can add variety and make treat time enjoyable. Even if your rabbit loves banana, moderation is very important.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcbn-benefits-grid">
          <article class="rcbn-benefit">
            <h3>Provides extra nutrients</h3>
            <p>Banana contains small amounts of useful nutrients, but should not be relied on as a main food.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbn-benefit">
            <h3>Adds variety</h3>
            <p>A tiny piece can add occasional variety to a hay-based diet.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbn-benefit">
            <h3>Bonding treat</h3>
            <p>Many rabbits eagerly take banana, making it useful for positive bonding sessions.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbn-benefit">
            <h3>Can tempt picky eaters</h3>
            <p>The smell and sweetness can encourage interest, but it should not be used to replace proper food.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbn-benefit">
            <h3>Signs they enjoy it</h3>
            <p>Your rabbit may run over quickly, grab the slice eagerly, chew fast or look for more.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbn-benefit">
            <h3>Still limit treats</h3>
            <p>Even enthusiastic rabbits should only have banana occasionally to keep their diet balanced.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>



    <section class="rcbn-faq rcbn-reveal" id="faqs" aria-label="Rabbit banana FAQs">
      <div class="rcbn-narrow">
        <div class="rcbn-panel">
          <div class="rcbn-section-header">
            <span class="rcbn-pill">FAQs</span>
            <h2>Rabbit banana FAQs</h2>
            <p>Quick answers to common questions about feeding banana to rabbits safely.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="rcbn-faq-list">
            <details class="rcbn-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat bananas safely?</summary>
              <p>Yes, rabbits can eat banana fruit safely in very small amounts. Banana is high in natural sugar, so it should only be an occasional treat and should never replace hay, water, leafy greens or a balanced rabbit diet.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcbn-faq-item">
              <summary>How much banana can I give my rabbit?</summary>
              <p>A sensible guide is a very small slice, around 1–2 teaspoons, once or twice per week at most. If your rabbit has never eaten banana before, start with a tiny amount and watch their appetite, poo and behaviour afterwards.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcbn-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat banana peels?</summary>
              <p>Banana peels are not usually recommended. They are not generally considered toxic, but they may carry pesticide residues or other unwanted chemicals. For most rabbits, feeding a tiny piece of banana fruit is safer and simpler.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcbn-faq-item">
              <summary>Can baby rabbits eat banana?</summary>
              <p>Baby rabbits should not be given sugary treats like banana. Young rabbits need an age-appropriate diet based around hay, suitable pellets and careful gradual introductions under appropriate guidance.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcbn-faq-item">
              <summary>What should I do if my rabbit eats too much banana?</summary>
              <p>Stop offering banana and watch your rabbit closely for changes in appetite, poo, behaviour or signs of discomfort. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems bloated or becomes unwell, contact a rabbit-savvy vet urgently.</p>
            </details>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcbn-final rcbn-reveal">
      <div class="rcbn-wrap rcbn-final-box">
        <span class="rcbn-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Bananas can be a tasty occasional treat for rabbits</h2>
        <p>
          Bananas are safe for rabbits and can be a tasty treat when offered in small amounts. However, because bananas are high in sugar, they should only be given occasionally.
        </p>
        <p>
          A rabbit’s diet should still consist mainly of hay, with fresh vegetables and leafy greens making up the rest of their daily food. When fed responsibly, a small slice of banana can be a fun and rewarding treat that many rabbits will happily enjoy.
        </p>
